# MCP Status

> MCP Status (https://mcp-status-directory.netlify.app) is a health-ranked directory of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Every listing carries a dated, evidence-based health score (0-100) from public signals: GitHub repo exists, archived flag, last push recency, whether the npm/PyPI package resolves, and stars. Archived and stale servers are flagged explicitly.

Last full check: 2026-10-16T07:52:31Z. 73 servers: 44 Healthy, 24 Stale, 5 Archived.

## Key pages
- [Ranked list of all servers](https://mcp-status-directory.netlify.app/)
- [Status / archived & stale flags](https://mcp-status-directory.netlify.app/status.html)
- [Methodology](https://mcp-status-directory.netlify.app/methodology.html)
- [Raw data JSON](https://mcp-status-directory.netlify.app/data/servers.json)

## Best MCP servers by use case (healthiest first, as of 2026-10-16)
- Browser & scraping: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp (99), microsoft/playwright-mcp (99), apify/apify-mcp-server (98)
- Dev tools & git: GLips/Figma-Context-MCP (98), mrexodia/ida-pro-mcp (98), mobile-next/mobile-mcp (98)
- Databases: crystaldba/postgres-mcp (87), benborla/mcp-server-mysql (87), googleapis/mcp-toolbox (78)
- Files & office: wonderwhy-er/DesktopCommanderMCP (98), haris-musa/excel-mcp-server (97)
- Search: exa-labs/exa-mcp-server (97), blazickjp/arxiv-mcp-server (97), anysearch-ai/anysearch-mcp-server (77)
- Cloud & infra: Flux159/mcp-server-kubernetes (96), awslabs/mcp (78), cloudflare/mcp-server-cloudflare (77)
- Productivity: czlonkowski/n8n-mcp (99), makenotion/notion-mcp-server (97, README says no longer actively maintained), stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server (97)
- AI & memory: jamubc/gemini-mcp-tool (87), cjo4m06/mcp-shrimp-task-manager (72), BeehiveInnovations/pal-mcp-server (58)
- Other: ahujasid/mcp-for-blender (99), CursorTouch/Windows-MCP (98), antvis/mcp-server-chart (87)
